::: {#thm-normal-vector-uphill}

#### Stepping along the normal vector

Let $\modmemf{\vx} = \dprod{\vcoef}{\vx} + \intcoef$ with $\vcoef \neq \vzero$.
For every $\vx \in \reals^p$ and $t \in \reals$,

$$
\modmemf{\vx + t\vcoef} = \modmemf{\vx} + t\normsq{\vcoef}.
$$

So a step along $\vcoef$ with $t > 0$ increases $\modmem$.

:::

::: proof
By linearity of the [dot product](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-dot-product),

$$
\begin{aligned}
\modmemf{\vx + t\vcoef}
&= \dprod{\vcoef}{\vx + t\vcoef} + \intcoef \\
&= \dprod{\vcoef}{\vx} + t\dprod{\vcoef}{\vcoef} + \intcoef \\
&= \modmemf{\vx} + t\normsq{\vcoef}.
\end{aligned}
$$
:::
